clauses.text:
By virtue o f the authority vested in me by the Foreign Assistance A ct 
o f 1961, as am ended, and section 301 o f title 3 o f the U nited States 
Code, and as President o f the U nited States, it is hereby ordered as 
follow s:
Executive O rder N o. 10973 o f N ovem ber 3, 1961, as amended, is 
hereby amended by adding at the end o f Part III a new section 306, 
as follow s:
“ Sec . 306. Development Coordination Committee,  (a ) In accordance 
with section 640B o f the act, there is hereby established a Development 
Coordination Committee (hereinafter referred to as the C om m ittee). 
The Committee shall consist o f the Administrator o f the Agency for 
International Developm ent, w ho shall be Chairm an; the U nder Secre­
tary o f State for E conom ic A ffairs; the U nder Secretary o f the Treasury 
for M onetary A ffairs; the U nder Secretary o f Com m erce; the Under 
Secretary o f Agriculture; the U nder Secretary o f L abor; the Special 
Representative for Trade Negotiations; an Associate D irector o f the 
Office o f M anagement and Budget; the Executive D irector o f the Coun­
cil on International E conom ic P olicy; a representative o f the Assistant 
to the President for national security affairs; the President o f the Export- 
Import Bank o f the U nited States; and the President o f the Overseas 
Private Investment Corporation.
“ (b) W henever matters within the jurisdiction o f the Committee may 
be o f interest to Federal agencies not represented on the Committee 
under paragraph (a ) o f this section, the Chairman o f the Committee 
may consult with such agencies and may invite them to designate repre­
sentatives to participate in meetings and deliberations o f the Committee.
“ (c) U nder the foreign policy guidance o f the Secretary o f State, the 
Committee shall advise the President with respect to coordination o f 
United States policies and programs affecting the development o f the 
developing countries, including programs o f bilateral and multilateral 
development assistance.
“ (d) A ll agencies and officers o f the Government shall keep the Com ­
mittee inform ed in necessary detail as to the policies, programs, and 
activities referred to in paragraph ( c )  o f this Section.
“ (e) Nothing herein shall be deemed to derogate from  the responsi­
bilities o f the Secretary o f State, the Secretary o f the Treasury, or from  
responsibilities vested elsewhere by law or other Executive orders.”

status_research.producer_scope: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
status_research.rationale: I read the complete held EO 11841 original (40 FR 8933): its only operative act is to add a new section 306 (Development Coordination Committee) at the end of Part III of EO 10973, as amended. I read the held EO 12163 text (44 FR 56673): section 1-903(a)(1) revokes 'Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended', and section 1-506 re-establishes a Development Coordination Committee under section 640B of the Act with new membership. EO 11841 is not named in the revocation, but the order it amended is revoked in full 'as amended', so the added section 306 has nothing to operate on and is replaced by 1-506; EO 11841 contains no independent command. EO 12163 section 1-904 continues earlier actions and regulations only until amended or terminated; it is a savings clause for actions, not for the continued operation of section 306. EO 11959 and 12118 further amend EO 10973 and do not name EO 11841. The inference that revoking the parent as amended ends the amendment is mine and is the point the reviewer should test; the catalog note 'Revoked by: EO 12163, September 29, 1979' is a lead only. Provisional NO hypothesis; lifecycle chronology remains a gap.

reviews.rationale: Independent reading: EO 11841 (40 FR 8933) has one operative act, adding sec. 306 (Development Coordination Committee) to EO 10973 'as amended'. Held EO 12163 (44 FR 56673) sec. 1-903(a)(1) revokes 'Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended' and sec. 1-506 establishes a new Development Coordination Committee. EO 11841 is not named, but its only content was inserted into EO 10973 and is revoked with it 'as amended'; 1-904 saves delegations, regulations and other actions not the inserted provision. Same pure-amendment reasoning as accepted for EO 13137 in y1_01. I agree: NO (by the parent-revoked-as-amended inference, stated as such).
